resources.name: left-over-lab-ip
resources.monthly_cost_risk: AWS charges hourly for every public IPv4 address, and this one is not even attached to a running resource.
resources.suggested_action: Release this Elastic IP manually if you no longer need a static address. It is likely leftover from a deleted instance.

resources.name: tutorial-scratch-volume
resources.monthly_cost_risk: Unattached volumes still cost money per GB-month even though nothing is using them.
resources.suggested_action: Review this orphaned volume. If it holds no data you need, snapshot it (optional) and delete it manually.

resources.name: bastion-address
resources.monthly_cost_risk: Since February 2024 AWS charges hourly for all public IPv4 addresses, including Elastic IPs attached to an instance.
resources.suggested_action: Keep while the attached resource is in use.
